newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends lower as banks buy greenbacks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends lower as banks buy greenbacks.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Saturday after strong buying of the greenback by foreign banks, dealers said.
The local unit ended Saturday's abbreviated session at T$27.570 against Friday's T$27.534 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$134.5 million.

Dealers said the local currency was hit by central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong's comment on Friday that the bank had no immediate plans to intervene in the foreign exchange market despite the U.S. dollar's recent strength.
"Sheu's comment assured investors that they could continue to track the U.S. dollar's strong overseas performance," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.52 to $27.59 range was seen for Monday.
